product.description: Replacement backlit keyboard for the HP Elite Dragonfly G2. Japanese (JIS) layout, backlit. This is the Japanese version, not US or UK, so the key legends and Enter key shape follow the Japanese standard. Tested before dispatch.

faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP Elite Dragonfly G2. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is this a Japanese layout?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is the Japanese (JIS) layout, not US or UK. It has the Japanese key legends and a different Enter key shape from a US keyboard. If you need a US or UK layout instead, message us on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Is this backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is the backlit version.
